records.title: WaveSSM: Multiscale State-Space Models for Non-stationary Signal Attention
records.reason: WaveSSM uses localized wavelet-frame state-space representations for sequence signals and reports wins over S4 on four of six LRA tasks. The authors note difficulty on very long-context Pathfinder/PathX tasks. The sequence-efficiency idea is adjacent, but the paper does not evaluate LLMs or serving.

records.title: A Benchmark for Deep Information Synthesis
records.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates a benchmark for LLM agents synthesizing information across sources. It measures agent task ability rather than proposing an inference optimization or serving mechanism.

records.title: Real-Time Hybrid Query Transformation Method for Enhancing Search System Performance in Korean Language Applications
records.reason: Primary DOI https://doi.org/10.31803/tg-20250410040449 was inaccessible. The abstract describes rule preprocessing plus a Transformer postprocessor for Korean-language search; full text needed to assess the linked hybrid-inference connection and any measured serving efficiency.

records.title: Beyond Subject-Specific Models in Dynamical Human--Machine Interaction: Benchmarking and Optimization Strategies
records.reason: Sequence-model benchmark for EMG-based human-machine control; not language-model inference.

records.title: VariBASed: Variational Bayes-Adaptive Sequential Monte-Carlo Planning for Deep Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: VariBASed develops Bayesian belief approximation and sequential Monte-Carlo planning for deep reinforcement learning. Its reported target is decision-making/data efficiency in control, not LLM inference or serving; the paper also depends on approximate value functions/importance weights.
